options.description: Configure the capability so it runs for real instead of its fallback
consequences: The capability reports live on its next run and this Decision stops recurring

options.description: Remove the capability from spec.required in .ai-sdlc/capabilities.yaml
consequences: The doctor check and this Decision stop covering it; the fallback keeps running

body:
Required capability `estimation.class-assignment` is never-observed.
Nothing is blocked: the capability runs its fallback. See docs/operations/capability-liveness.md.
